title: kpidash client health
description: Payload of kpidash:client:{host}:health — latest-value, SET EX 5, written ~3 s. Key absence = client offline.

hostname.description: Lowercase system hostname; must match the {host} key segment

last_seen_ts.description: Unix seconds (float) of this ping, writer's clock

availability.description: Optional (kpidash sprint 023). A host that sleeps by design sends "intermittent", so a dashboard can draw its expired key as asleep rather than offline. Absent means always-on, and every pre-023 payload is unchanged. A reader keeps the last value it saw past the key's expiry, and treats any other value as absent. Listed in kdashdata sprint 018 (WI 3179).

x-counterexamples.why: the host pattern requires 1..63 characters; an empty hostname is an unset variable that reached the payload
`last_seen_ts` is the whole point of a health key — without it the TTL is the only liveness signal and the payload says nothing
`intermittent` is the only value; kpidash reads anything else as absent, so a typo draws a sleeping host red — the contract names the mistake instead of letting it pass as always-on
